message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzz/fuzz_config_init/fuzz_config_init.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 48, "var": "data", "code": "char *str = (char *)malloc(size + 1); memcpy(str, data, size); str[size] = '\\0';", "note": "Attacker-controlled truncated XML config bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated string."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "fuzz/fuzz_config_init/fuzz_config_init.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 55, "var": "cfgst", "code": "cfgst = ddsi_config_init(str, &gv.config, 0)", "note": "The truncated XML config string is parsed; the NetworkPartition element is opened but never closed, so the parser encounters an error."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/core/ddsi/src/ddsi_config.c", "function": "if_network_partition", "line": 722, "var": "new->interface_names", "code": "new->address_string = NULL; new->uc_addresses = NULL; new->asm_addresses = NULL; new->name = NULL;", "note": "The network partition list element is allocated via ddsrt_malloc (uninitialized heap memory) and several fields are set to NULL, but interface_names is NOT initialized, leaving it as uninitialized heap garbage."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/core/ddsi/src/ddsi_config.c", "function": "ddsi_config_init", "line": 2655, "var": "cfgst", "code": "error: free_configured_elements(cfgst, cfgst->cfg, root_cfgelems);", "note": "Because the XML is truncated, the parser fails and the error cleanup path frees all configured elements, including the partially-initialized NetworkPartition element. set_defaults was never called for the Interface attribute since the element never closed."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/core/ddsi/src/ddsi_config.c", "function": "free_configured_elements", "line": 1690, "var": "cfgst", "code": "free_all_elements(cfgst, cfgst->cfg, root_cfgelems)", "note": "Walks the config element tree and invokes the free function for each configured attribute, including the uninitialized interface_names field of the NetworkPartition element."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/core/ddsi/src/ddsi_config.c", "function": "ff_free", "line": 773, "var": "*elem", "code": "void ** const elem = cfg_address(cfgst, parent, cfgelem); ddsrt_free(*elem);", "note": "ff_free dereferences the uninitialized interface_names pointer and passes it to ddsrt_free, causing an invalid free on garbage heap memory."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')" && bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.xml /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 1.
